title.en: LLM reliability as the context grows — GDM-MRCR v2, 8 needles (Context Arena)
title.fr: Fiabilité des LLM quand le contexte s'allonge — GDM-MRCR v2, 8 aiguilles (Context Arena)

decision: method of streamtex-all-trainings (data JSON with sources + drawing tool, rule m1); ai4se6d chart design kept; same-generation and complete-results rules (NG 2026-11-22)

benchmark.name: GDM-MRCR v2, 8 needles
benchmark.method: Multi-round co-reference resolution: a long fictional conversation in which the user made exactly the same request 8 times (« write a poem about tapirs ») and received a different answer each time, among dozens of similar requests with other formats, topics or styles; at the end the model must reproduce the n-th of the 8 answers (e.g. the 3rd poem about tapirs), preceded by a random string. Same task at every length: only the surrounding conversation grows.
benchmark.metric: mean similarity to the reference answer (0-100), not a right/wrong accuracy
benchmark.chance_source: Google DeepMind, eval_hub mrcr_v2 README: guessing among the needles scores about 15 % with 8 needles
benchmark.measured_by: Dillon Uzar (Context Arena), third party, same harness for every model
benchmark.bins_note: a bin is named by its upper bound: 8K = (4K, 8K] tokens … 1M = (512K, 1M]
notes: Rule m1: for each model, the highest reasoning effort measured.
Same generation: models put online between 2026-05-13 and 2026-08-13 (about three months).
Complete results: a score at every length up to 512K tokens.
Grok 4.6 left out: no score at 512K (every model must be measured at each length up to 512K).
Mistral Medium 3.5 left out: online 2026-04-30, outside the generation window (2026-05-13 .. 2026-08-13).
Above 512K only Gemini has a point (the 1M prompts do not fit the other models' windows).
